# Extract add/remove suggestions from all comment contents
adds=[]
removes=[]
for c in comments:
    lines=c['content'].splitlines()
    for line in lines:
        line=line.strip()
        if line.startswith('add =>'):
            val=line.replace('add =>','',1).strip()
            # format: Song by Artist
            m=re.match(r'(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+)$', val)
            if m:
                title=m.group(1).strip()
                artist=m.group(2).strip()
                adds.append((title, artist))
        if line.startswith('remove =>'):
            val=line.replace('remove =>','',1).strip()
            m=re.match(r'(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+)$', val)
            if m:
                title=m.group(1).strip()
                artist=m.group(2).strip()
                removes.append((title, artist))

# Deduplicate while preserving order

def dedupe(seq):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for item in seq:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item); out.append(item)
    return out

adds=dedupe(adds)
removes=dedupe(removes)
print('adds', adds)
print('removes', removes)

# helper to search all pages

def search_song_exact(title, artist, query=None):
    # Use query that includes both for better relevance; still must scan all pages.
    q = query if query is not None else f"{title} {artist}"
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    matches = []
    while True:
        res = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        # res is a list
        print('search_songs',q,'page',page_index,'len',len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        for item in res:
            t = norm(item.get('title'))
            artists = item.get('artists') or []
            artist_names = [norm(a.get('name')) for a in artists]
            if t == norm(title) and norm(artist) in artist_names:
                matches.append(item)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 100:
            break
    return matches

add_song_ids = []
for title, artist in spotify_adds:
    matches = search_song_exact(title, artist)
    print('ADD',title,'by',artist,'matches',[(m.get('song_id'), m.get('title'), [a.get('name') for a in (m.get('artists') or [])]) for m in matches])
    if matches:
        add_song_ids.append((title, artist, matches[0]['song_id']))
    else:
        add_song_ids.append((title, artist, None))

print('add_song_ids', add_song_ids)

# Apply Todoist suggestions to Spotify playlist 654.
# Assumes spotify_token, playlist_id, remove_matches, add_song_ids from earlier blocks.

playlist_id = 654
spotify_token = spotify_token  # from earlier

todoist_token = res['access_token']

remove_song_ids = [292,117,35,247]
add_song_ids = [36,280,277]

print('Removing', remove_song_ids)
remove_results=[]
for sid in remove_song_ids:
    r = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    remove_results.append((sid,r))
    print('removed',sid,'->',r)

print('Adding', add_song_ids)
add_results=[]
for sid in add_song_ids:
    r = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    add_results.append((sid,r))
    print('added',sid,'->',r)

# Verify playlist membership in a single read call
pl_after = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
song_ids_after = [s.get('id') for s in pl_after.get('songs',[])]
print('playlist_title_after', pl_after.get('title'))
print('playlist_song_count_after', len(song_ids_after))

present_add = {sid: (sid in song_ids_after) for sid in add_song_ids}
absent_remove = {sid: (sid not in song_ids_after) for sid in remove_song_ids}
print('present_add', present_add)
print('absent_remove', absent_remove)

# Todoist: post final comment 'Done!' and mark task complete

task_id = 6341
comment_res = apis.todoist.post_task_comment(task_id=task_id, content='Done!', access_token=todoist_token)
print('comment_res', comment_res)

update_res = apis.todoist.update_task(task_id=task_id, access_token=todoist_token, is_completed=True)
print('update_res', update_res)

# Supervisor: complete the active supervisor task
sup_res = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print('sup_res', sup_res)
